info.title: OpenMercantil API
info.summary: Versioned public-read, browser-account, billing, support and provider-callback contracts.
info.description:
Public JSON API for Spanish company information derived from BORME and other public sources. OpenMercantil is an independent informational service; it is NOT the BOE, BORME or Registro Mercantil and does NOT replace official certificates or registry extracts.

**Rate limits.** Free: 60 req/min y 200 req/día por IP. Planes superiores (Profesional 5.000 req/día, MAX 50.000 req/día, Enterprise 500.000+ req/día) según cuenta y API key. Cabeceras `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`, `X-OpenMercantil-Plan`, `Retry-After`.

**License and attribution.** Source-specific metadata in each response and the active versioned source catalog prevails. OpenMercantil does not relicense upstream content under a blanket license. Unknown, review and restricted datasets are omitted or return `503 legal_layer_unavailable`. BOE/BORME material is re-used under Ley 37/2007 and its official version remains boe.es. Court judgments are not exposed; CENDOJ remains citation-index only under CGPJ Reglamento 3/2010.

**Machine-readable catalog (DCAT-AP-ES):** https://openmercantil.es/catalog.rdf

license.name: Source-specific upstream terms; see response catalog metadata

info.x-contract-status: Public read, browser-account and provider-callback surfaces are explicitly separated in this contract. Operator/admin routes are excluded. The public MCP consumes only the allowlisted GET read plane.

x-account-segment-contract.count_semantics: The segment run response count is the number of rows returned, never a global total. Dataset preview uses total_is_lower_bound=true and total_lower_bound when the bounded count reaches 50001.

x-company-identity-contract.applies_to: Every /api/v1/company/{slug}*, /api/v1/empresa/{slug}* and /api/v1/grafo/{slug} read before any report, cache, graph or dataset lookup. /api/v1/companies/compare resolves both requested subjects in one bounded company_public_v2 batch before either row is exposed; MCP company tools inherit these preflights through REST.

resolution.withheld: neutral 404; includes absent, personal and ambiguous/quarantined identities
resolution.unavailable: 503 with no-store; clients must not infer absence

x-company-identity-contract.search: Exact corporate CIF, exact canonical/safe-alias slug, or bounded name_prefix2 pool scored in application code. DNI/NIE and ambiguous CIFs return zero items.

tags.name: Persons

tags.name: Sectors

tags.name: BORME
tags.description: Daily BORME publications, multi-source timeline and registry events

tags.name: Risk Signals
tags.description: Documentary risk signals from public sources (AEPD, CNMC, concursos, AEAT moroso, CENDOJ)

tags.name: Graph
tags.description: Corporate and person-to-company relationship graphs. Every emitted record retains the source-specific terms authorized by the active public source catalog; no blanket relicensing applies.

tags.name: Sources
tags.description: Source catalog metadata, freshness and integration status

tags.name: Integrations
tags.description: Public read-only connector catalog. Never exposes credentials, OAuth tokens, webhook secrets or operator actions.

tags.name: User
tags.description: Authenticated Panel Pro endpoints — segments, lists, notes, tags, exports, audit. Requires session cookie (browser) and X-CSRF-Token header for mutations.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Session-bound Stripe checkout, invoices and portal contracts. External actions are bounded, idempotent and never exposed through the public MCP.

tags.name: Support
tags.description: Customer-support writes. Anonymous creation requires explicit privacy consent; replies require an authenticated owner session and CSRF. Ticket data is never exposed through the public MCP.

tags.name: Legal
tags.description: Spanish mercantile-law layer (derecho mercantil): legislation corpus + article texts + act→norm bridge. Distributes the consolidated BOE legal corpus structured by OpenMercantil so LLMs and agents can cite it as a source. License: consolidated text from the BOE, reused under Ley 37/2007 (re-use of public sector information); the official version is always boe.es. Informational only — NOT legal advice. Court judgments are NOT exposed here (CENDOJ is kept as a citation-index only, per CGPJ Reglamento 3/2010); this layer distributes legislation + the act↔norm index.

get.description: Return BORME events for a known company slug, optionally filtered by calendar year. The closed scalar query contract rejects unknown names, arrays and malformed integer values with 400; valid integers outside their bounds return 422. If year is omitted, the server freezes the current UTC year for the request. Historical coverage starts at 1900 and year must be less than or equal to the current UTC year; there is no fixed calendar ceiling.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Calendar year from 1900 through the current UTC year (year <= current UTC year). Defaults dynamically to the current UTC year.

get.description: Cursor-paginated PLACSP notice search over the materialized legal-first projection. The query contract is closed-world and scalar: unknown names, arrays and lexical type mismatches return 400; validly typed values outside documented ranges return 422. Full-text query indexes notice object and buyer only; it never indexes supplier names. Full-text plus structured filters returns 422 until a compound offline projection exists. CPV accepts an indexed 2-8 digit prefix, may combine only with published_from/published_to, and returns 503 rather than falling back when its CPV-date projection or exact index is unavailable. supplier_cif is resolved by the generation-bound offline 0062 projection and matches either the notice's top-level corporate adjudicatario or any materialized corporate coadjudicator. It may combine with phase, buyer_nif, province and publication dates; open_only and every monetary filter require a future compound projection and return 422. Because one notice can have several adjudicators, a search summary may display a different admitted top-level supplier; tender detail retains the complete materialized result set. Natural-person supplier names and identifiers are withheld together. Budget, estimated value and award are separate source-reported fields and none proves paid or executed spend. open_only freezes one UTC date for SQL filtering, row is_open semantics and cursor binding.
get.x-privacy: Natural-person and uncertain buyer/supplier identity is withheld. buyer_nif and supplier_cif accept entity identifiers only.

x-query-contract.combinations: supplier_cif supports phase, buyer_nif, province and publication dates; supplier_cif plus open_only or amount_kind/min_amount_eur/max_amount_eur returns 422 until a compound projection exists

UserSegmentFilters.description: Corporate-only filters executed exclusively over the immutable company_public_v2 sidecar. At least one effective anchor is required: provincia, cnae_prefix, a capital bound, a year bound or recent_days. `forma` and `estado` are deliberately not accepted; stored legacy filters containing either fail closed. Without provincia/cnae_prefix, capital and temporal anchors cannot be combined; capital-only anchors accept only capital_desc/capital_asc (or the default), and temporal-only anchors accept only recent/oldest (or the default).

features.description: Runtime feature health. Cheap signals only (env + offline counters); no live query in the request path.

CnaeNode.description: CNAE node. Catalog loaders may add official explanatory fields.

PersonSearchItem.description: Documentary person search result; no DNI, contact data or personal address.

CompanyLeiResponse.description: Current GLEIF helper shape. The source-policy gate may make this operation unavailable; has_lei=false is the runtime empty shape, not independent proof of non-registration.

CompanyBdeResponse.description: Banco de Espana Central de Balances ratios for the company's two-digit CNAE sector. These are sector metrics, not a supervised-entity record or company score.

CompanyCnmvResponse.description: Generation-bound minimized CNMV view. A null listing or empty events array describes this bounded projection only.

WikidataCompanyRecord.description: Structured CC0 subset only; no label, logo, website, CEO, LEI, Wikipedia text or media.

CompanyWikidataResponse.description: Generation-bound minimized Wikidata company view. Empty describes the bounded projection only.

TedContractRecord.description: Minimized, attested TED notice. Tenderer, currency and connector free text are excluded.

CompanyTedResponse.description: Generation-bound minimized TED view. count is the total projected row count; returned_count is the bounded slice length.

CompanyAccountsResponse.description: Current annual-accounts aggregate helper response. The operation remains source-policy gated; al_dia and has_financials are runtime aggregate flags, not registry certificates.

FinancialAccountsRecord.description: Source-precedence annual-accounts row emitted under a year key. Monetary values are integer euros derived from stored cents; no accounting concept is inferred.

EmbargoRecord.description: Documentary official-notice record; may not reflect later unpublished resolutions.

CompanyEnrichmentResponse.description: Policy-filtered enrichment envelope. Only public catalog sources survive egress filtering.

JsonValue.description: A JSON value used only inside explicitly documented extension maps.

cpv_prefix_filter.description: Indexed offline 2-8 digit prefix coverage; undated projection rows are excluded.

projection_generation.description: Immutable PLACSP projection generation used for this response.

company_public_generation.description: Immutable company_public_v2 generation that revalidated the requested company identity.

TenderCollectionMetadata.description: Hard response bounds and per-collection truncation flags. Truncation never triggers an unbounded fallback.

UserSegment.description: Saved account segment. Extra migration columns may be returned for backward compatibility.

count.description: Number of rows returned in this bounded response. It is not an exact global match count.

UserListItem.description: Saved list item owned by the authenticated account.

UserList.description: Saved user list; migration columns may be appended.

UserNote.description: Private note visible only to its authenticated owner.

UserTag.description: Private account tag and optional aggregate usage count.

UserAuditEntry.description: Account audit entry. Sensitive metadata is not part of the public contract.

SupportTicketCategory.description: Stable support-routing category accepted by the current account schema.

SupportTicketCreateRequest.description: Customer-supplied support content. Privacy consent is purpose-bound to handling and protecting this request; it is not marketing consent.

name.description: Trimmed before persistence; ASCII control characters are rejected.

subject.description: Trimmed before length validation; ASCII control characters are rejected.

body.description: Trimmed before length validation. TAB, CR and LF are permitted; other ASCII control characters are rejected.

related_company_slug.description: Optional validated context; it does not establish identity or ownership.

related_url.description: Optional context restricted at runtime to a single-slash absolute same-origin path or an HTTPS URL on exactly openmercantil.es, without userinfo, port, backslash or control characters. Query and fragment are removed before persistence. The URL is stored as text and never dereferenced.

accept_privacy.description: Strict purpose-bound acceptance, persisted as privacy_accepted/privacy_policy_v1; never interpreted as marketing consent.

code.description: Present on selected fail-closed or anti-abuse helper failures.

retry_after.description: Present when the per-IP support creation ceiling is exhausted.

SupportRequestErrorResponse.description: Support validation/ownership errors carry `ok=false`; shared body-reader and action-budget errors use the generic API error envelope.

LegalReportRequest.description: The body carries only the CSRF fallback. Entitlement, pricing, beta status and the daily idempotency key are server-owned.

LegalReportAxis.description: One documentary axis in the redacted corporate legal-history projection. Presence records sourced events; it does not assert wrongdoing, solvency, current status or identity beyond the corporate subject guard.

StripeWebhookEventRequest.description: Stripe Event envelope. The exact signed raw bytes, not a reserialized object, are used for verification. Provider extension fields remain typed JSON and are not reflected to callers.

id.description: Provider event id and durable idempotency key.

BillingInvoice.description: Authenticated user's invoice metadata; URLs point to Stripe-hosted documents.

CsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfHeader.description: Fresh token returned by GET /api/v1/user/me for this authenticated session.

AccountIdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
AccountIdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Required for account mutations that reveal a secret. Reuse the same key only for an identical payload. The encrypted response can be replayed for 24 hours; a changed payload or an expired key returns 409.

CompanySlugPath.name: slug
CompanySlugPath.description: Exact corporate slug admitted by company_public_v2; no empty segments, leading/trailing hyphen or repeated separator.

IfNoneMatchHeader.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatchHeader.description: Optional RFC 9110 entity-tag validator. Weak validators, comma-separated validator lists and `*` are accepted.

ValidationFailed.description: The query is lexically valid but outside a documented numeric or length bound, or uses an unsupported indexed combination.

PayloadTooLarge.description: JSON request body exceeds the 65536-byte account API limit.

InternalServerError.description: The bounded operation failed without exposing internal exception details.

LegalLayerUnavailable.description: Controlled fail-closed denial: the required dataset or legal layer is absent, invalid, unsupported or not authorized for this public surface.

example.detail: Este dataset no esta habilitado para redistribucion publica por la politica de fuentes activa.

PublicReadUnavailable.description: The public read failed closed because its legal source catalog, subject classification, bounded projection, database helper or required artifact is unavailable. Clients must not infer an empty result.

Cache-Control.description: Unavailable public reads are never cacheable.

Retry-After.description: Optional number of seconds to wait before retrying.

value.detail: La proyección pública requerida no está disponible.

XDataSources.description: Comma-separated aliases from the active public source catalog that contributed to the response. Omitted only when a valid exact filter returns an empty representation with zero contributing sources.

XSourceCatalogVersion.description: Mandatory on every successful public GET. Exact version of the legal source catalog used to authorize the response.

XAttributionRequired.description: Optional. When present, comma-separated public source aliases whose attribution terms must accompany reuse.

CompanyCompareContentLocation.description: Canonical comparison URL with the two canonical slugs in stable lexical order.

EntityTag.description: Strong generation-bound entity tag for conditional GET.

PrivateRevalidationCacheControl.description: Caller-specific rate-limit and plan headers make this representation private. A private cache may retain the body but must revalidate every request; shared caches must not store or reuse it.

NoStoreCacheControl.description: Error responses must not be stored.

StatsGeneration.description: Exact shared generation of the active CCAA, sector, sources and global-counters bundle.

CompanyContentLocation.description: Present when a safe historical company alias was accepted and processed as its canonical company slug.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: True when this response was recovered from the durable encrypted replay record for the same key and payload.

IdempotencyKeyExpires.description: Unix timestamp after which this key cannot replay the one-time secret and a fresh key is required.

cookieAuth.name: ob_sess
cookieAuth.description: Browser session cookie set after login at /mi-cuenta/login. Mutations also require X-CSRF-Token header (obtain via GET /api/v1/user/me).

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Optional opaque omk_* API credential for public GETs. Anonymous access remains valid; a credential with the operation's x-api-credential-scope (or public:read) selects its account quota. Never place credentials in query strings.

bearerAuth.description: Optional Authorization: Bearer transport for the same opaque omk_* API credential accepted by X-API-Key. It is not a JWT or OAuth access token.

x-api-credential-scopes.public:read: Umbrella scope accepted by every public read route except bulk exports.
x-api-credential-scopes.companies:read: Companies, BORME, CNAE sectors and public aggregates.
